error.not_installed: ccas is not installed. Run: ccas install
error.not_installed_wrapper: ccas is not installed. Run the installer: ccas install
error.claude_not_found: claude not found. Install Claude Code or pass the path: ccas install --claude-path <path>
error.real_claude_missing: the original claude is missing. Repair the install: ccas doctor
error.unknown_alias: no account with alias '{alias}'. List them: ccas list
error.unknown_slot: there is no slot {slot}. List them: ccas list
error.no_such_account: no account matches '{target}'. List them: ccas list
error.alias_numeric: an alias cannot be a number, it would clash with a slot number
install.cred_mode_copy: copying (this claude build has no isolation support)
install.reopen_terminal: Open a new terminal so PATH is picked up.
uninstall.purged: Fully removed, including the stored tokens.
uninstall.purge_hint: To remove everything including tokens: ccas uninstall --purge
uninstall.reopen_terminal: Open a new terminal so PATH is refreshed.
uninstall.confirm_purge: Delete everything, including the stored tokens of every account?
wrapper.login_needed: Slot {slot} has no saved login yet - sign in.
wrapper.concurrent: Slot {held} is already running. In copy mode both slots share one credentials file, so slot {wanted} cannot start until that session is closed.
cli.no_slots_hint: No slots yet. Run `claude` and sign in - a slot is created automatically.
cli.run_claude_hint: Run `claude` and it will start on it.
cli.free_slot_hint: Run `claude {slot}` and sign in - the slot saves itself.
cli.confirm_remove: Delete slot {slot} ({label}) together with its tokens?
cli.slot_renamed: Slot {slot} is now '{alias}'. Launch with: claude @{alias}
cli.shell.hint: Type a command and press Enter: install, list, switch <n>, add, doctor, --help. Type 'exit' (or Ctrl+C) to close.
cli.shell.unknown: Unknown command. Type --help for the list, or 'exit' to close.
cli.description: Claude Code account switcher. Swaps only the credentials - history, projects, settings and plugins stay shared.
cli.help.install: install, or roll out a new version
cli.help.reinstall: same as install: roll out on top of an existing install
cli.help.refresh: query the limits over the network
cli.help.cached_list: show stored limits without querying the network
doctor.version_mismatch: the installed version is older than the one you ran - roll it out: ccas install
doctor.shim_dir_missing: shim directory is not on PATH - repair with: ccas install
doctor.intercept_pending: interception is not active in this terminal ({state}) - open a new one
doctor.cred_mode_copy: credential mode: copying - this claude build has no isolation support, so parallel work on different accounts is risky
doctor.no_slots: no slots - run `claude` and sign in
doctor.slot_world_readable: slot {slot}: the credentials file is readable by others - chmod 600
doctor.configs_drift: claude configs disagree about the account: {details}. The next switch will align them
menu.title: Choose an account:
menu.keys: up/down choose - Enter run - r refresh limits - q quit
menu.refresh_failed: could not refresh (no network, or the tokens are stale)
usage.refresh_partial: could not refresh {count} account(s) - see ccas doctor and the log
